proposals.rationale: A new 'high bandwidth memory' report came in with a strong verdict (score 80) and 49.6% confidence, just above the 45% minimum for a new buy. We hold nothing and have cash. The other new reports (OLED displays, AI agents, 6G, vision-language-action) are below the confidence minimum or not strong/building, and none of them has a candidate on offer. The HBM report is the only one that clears the buy rules. Its verified findings show real demand, for example FormFactor saying HBM for generative AI drove its DRAM probe card growth. Most of the supportive claims, such as 'sold out through 2027' and a DRAM deficit, are unverified X posts. Of the two HBM candidates, INTC has lower company-size risk and an unstretched price, so it is the more cautious single first position. Confidence stays low because the findings do not mention Intel directly; it is in the fund on the strength of its patents and filings.
risks: A tokenized stock (INTCon) depends on its issuer, Ondo, and is not the share itself.
